recordedAssertions.name: Pending and accepted unused Media rejects; rejected state and history persist and future processing/acceptance fails.
Visible Content locale and Current CV use return MEDIA_IN_USE with no rejection mutation.
Hiding and archiving Content and activating a replacement Current CV remove the affected use.
Draft, Hidden, and Archived references allow rejection; publish, restore, and CV approval revalidate rejected Media.
Decision, version, receipt, and event commit atomically; injected failure rolls back and exact replay survives later version changes.
Independent publication, restore, CV acceptance, and activation races with rejection serialize to valid outcomes.
Accept/reject concurrency, changed-hash reuse, stale versions, and terminal transitions fail safely.
Current authoritative usage reads protect writes; retained objects stay private and capability expiry is documented.
Private rejection reason is absent from public event data and errors expose safe codes only.
